lessons.title: تعمیرگاه (ta'mirgâh) — a garage, a repair shop

segments.text: Before the new one: say the Persian for one-way, then the Persian for a driving licence.
تعمیرگاه (ta'mirgâh) — "a garage, a repair shop".
ماشین را به تعمیرگاه بردیم. Mâshin râ be ta'mirgâh bordim. We took the car to the garage.
ta'mir 'repair' + gâh 'place'.
ta'mirgâh is built from ta'mir 'repair', a loan usually traced to Arabic taʿmīr 'making habitable, restoring', and the native gâh 'place'. EtymDB does not list it.
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.

lessons.title: تعمیر کردن (ta'mir kardan) — to repair, to fix

segments.text: Before the new one: say the Persian for a driving licence, then the Persian for a garage.

blocks.title: You'll want to know: تعمیر کردن

segments.text: تعمیر کردن (ta'mir kardan) — "to repair, to fix".
مکانیک ماشین را در دو روز تعمیر کرد. Mekânik mâshin râ dar do ruz ta'mir kard. The mechanic repaired the car in two days.
ta'mir + kardan. Present stem kon-: ta'mir mikonad.
ta'mir kardan is built from ta'mir 'repair', usually traced to Arabic taʿmīr 'restoring', and kardan 'to do', inherited from Middle Persian kardan (EtymDB).
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.

lessons.title: جوش آوردن (jush âvardan) — to overheat (of an engine); to boil over; to lose your temper
lessons.gloss: to overheat (of an engine); to boil over; to lose your temper

segments.text: Before the new one: say the Persian for a garage, then the Persian for to repair.

blocks.title: You'll want to know: جوش آوردن

segments.text: جوش آوردن (jush âvardan) — "to overheat (of an engine); to boil over; to lose your temper".
در گرمای تابستان ماشین ما جوش آورد. Dar garmâ-ye tâbestân mâshin-e mâ jush âvard. In the summer heat our car overheated.
jush 'boiling' + âvardan 'to bring'. Said of people too: jush âvard — he lost his temper.
jush âvardan is built from jush 'boiling, simmering', a native word that EtymDB lists, and âvardan 'to bring', usually traced to Middle Persian āwurdan.
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.

lessons.title: یدک کش (yadakkesh) — a tow truck, a breakdown lorry
lessons.gloss: a tow truck, a breakdown lorry

segments.text: Before the new one: say the Persian for to repair, then the Persian for to overheat.

blocks.title: You'll want to know: یدک کش

segments.text: یدک کش (yadakkesh) — "a tow truck, a breakdown lorry".
یدک کش (yadakkesh) ماشین ما را به تعمیرگاه برد. Yadakkesh mâshin-e mâ râ be ta'mirgâh bord. The tow truck took our car to the garage.
yadak 'spare, in tow' + kesh 'puller', from keshidan.
yadakkesh is built from yadak 'a led horse, a spare', usually traced to a Turkic word for a horse led on a rope, and kesh 'puller', from the native verb keshidan 'to pull'. EtymDB lists neither part.
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.

segments.text: بکسل کردن (boksel kardan) — "to tow".
برادرم ماشین خراب مرا با طناب بکسل کرد. Barâdaram mâshin-e kharâb-e marâ bâ tanâb boksel kard. My brother towed my broken-down car with a rope.
boksel (a tow rope) + kardan. Present stem kon-: boksel mikonad.
boksel kardan is built from boksel 'a tow, a tow rope', which EtymDB takes from Russian buksír 'towing', and kardan 'to do', inherited from Middle Persian kardan (EtymDB).
